proposal_title: Complete 15-Repository Acyclic Dependency DAG & Forbidden Matrix
domain_specific_rationale: From a Domain Architecture and Layering perspective, CP-010 establishes strict bounded context isolation and prevents domain model corruption across all 15 system repositories. It places R01 Contracts strictly at Layer 0 with zero inward or outward dependencies, establishing it as the pure schema source of truth. R02 Core State is isolated at Layer 1 as the sole custodian of transactional persistence, strictly prohibiting direct database access from domain services (R03-R05) and execution workers (R07-R13). The mathematically verified acyclic dependency DAG ensures that dependencies flow strictly from outer orchestrators/adapters toward inner domain contracts, conforming cleanly to Onion/Hexagonal architectural principles and preventing cyclical coupling.
capability_impact: Directly protects architectural integrity across all system capabilities (CAP-01 through CAP-12), ensuring clean separation between core domain state, workflow orchestration, and infrastructure execution adapters.
residual_risk: Future development could inadvertently introduce illegal imports violating the forbidden dependency matrix. Mitigated by automated CI static analysis rules and strict import boundary verification in R15 Integration Harness.
